shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/*.js styles/*.css; do echo "$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files app components lib pages 2>&1 && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
const base = 'http://localhost:3000'
const cases = [
  ['/', { headers: { 'user-agent': 'migration-smoke-test' } }, 200, 'migration-smoke-test'],
  ['/blog', {}, 200, 'All Blog Posts'],
  ['/blog/1', {}, 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['/blog/11', {}, 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['/blog/101', {}, 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
  ['/missing', {}, 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
  ['/api/posts', {}, 200, 'First Post'],
  ['/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'New', content: 'Body' }) }, 201, 'New'],
  ['/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: '' }) }, 400, 'Title and content are required'],
  ['/api/posts/1', {}, 200, 'Post 1'],
  ['/api/posts/1', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Updated' }) }, 200, 'Updated'],
  ['/api/posts/1', { method: 'DELETE' }, 200, 'deleted successfully'],
  ['/api/posts', { method: 'PUT' }, 405, ''],
]
let failed = false
for (const [path, init, status, expected] of cases) {
  const res = await fetch(base + path, init)
  const body = await res.text()
  const ok = res.status === status && body.includes(expected)
  console.log("'`${ok ? '"'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "'${init.method ?? '"'GET'} "'${path}: ${res.status}${!ok ? ` (expected ${status}, marker ${expected})` : '"''}"'`)
  failed ||= !ok
}
if (failed) process.exitCode = 1
NODE'

/bin/bash -lc 'test ! -e pages && echo '"'pages directory removed'; rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse\" app components lib || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && test ! -e pages && echo '"'pages absent' && rg --files app components lib"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && test ! -e pages && rg -n "next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps" app components lib || true'
